1. THE THREE EMPIRICAL VELOCITY ZONES & INVERSION THRESHOLDS
✓ Normal spontaneous blink rate; ocular fatigue suppressed
✗ Error rate exceeds 35%; severe tunnel vision
Blink reflex inhibited; rapid ocular desiccation
Information Presentation Speed ω (degrees of visual angle / sec)
Critical Discovery: The Decision Reaction Fallacy (Tong et al., 2026):
• Post-hoc analysis proved speed increases affect incorrect decisions, NOT omissions.
• Operators still perceive the moving stimulus, but executive cognitive evaluation
breaks down under speed stress, triggering erroneous control actions.
✓ Accuracy peaks at 4°/s – 8°/s (>95%); drops precipitously above 16°/s (p < 0.001).
Information Presentation Speed ω (degrees of visual angle / sec)
• In static HMIs, operators possess generous surplus attentional supply (S >> D).
• At speeds >8°/s, continuous smooth pursuit visual tracking consumes spare
bandwidth; at ~14°/s, demand exceeds supply, triggering situational collapse.
Notice Understanding (U) is invariant: failure is physiological, not comprehension!
Maximum task accuracy (>95%), minimal error rate, stable attentional supply
